text: someone left a stack of free newspapers in the building lobby. brought one up, read the crossword clues, filled in three, got stuck, folded it into a square so the creases line up.
it is 23:40 and the motorcycle couriers on seongsu-ro sound like they are driving through my living room.
floor at the studio is always freezing at 6:45. unwinding the springs on three reformers before anyone else arrives.
lumbar spine decided 4pm was the exact time to complain. ten minutes on the foam roller on the wooden floor.
first beginner class done. trying to explain neutral spine without using the word pelvis five times in one minute.
went to the mart for tofu and came back with three persimmons and an enamel pot i don't need.
